mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.login_id AS "teacherName", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date::text AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.attachment_ids::text AS "attachmentIds", a.created_at::text AS "createdAt", a.updated_at::text AS "updatedAt", a.created_by AS "createdBy", a.updated_by AS "updatedBy", a.request_id AS "requestId", d.performance_content AS "achievementContent", d.academic_year AS "academicYear", d.semester_code::integer AS "semester"
FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'lecture-improvements' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.management_item_id AS "managementItemId", m.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", m.management_item_name AS "managementItemName", s.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_element_management_item_settings s ON s.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id AND s.area_code = a.area_code AND s.item_code = i.item_code AND s.element_code = e.element_code AND s.management_item_code = m.management_item_code AND s.evaluation_year = e.evaluation_year WHERE m.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.evaluation_year = #{year} AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN s.effective_start_date AND s.effective_end_date AND (s.target_scope = 'ALL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings om WHERE om.user_id = #{userId} AND om.status = 'ACTIVE' AND om.organization_code = s.target_scope )) ORDER BY m.management_item_code, m.management_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code ) VALUES (#{id}, #{body.achievementContent}, #{body.academicYear}, CAST(#{body.semester} AS varchar))
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'lecture-improvements' AND achievement_status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details SET performance_content = #{body.achievementContent}, academic_year = #{body.academicYear}, semester_code = CAST(#{body.semester} AS varchar) WHERE achievement_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('lecture-improvements', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actor}, #{requestId})
